correctness.rationale: The smooth genus-five complete intersection is verified by the nonzero 3-by-3 coefficient minors and adjunction. Five elliptic quotient maps give an isogeny with kernel killed by 8, thus the 3-divisible group splits. In characteristic three the Legendre Hasse coefficient equals -(1+lambda); the five displayed divisor equations follow. For any two distinct four-subsets of five branch points, the shared three points normalize to infinity,0,1; supersingularity of both would force both distinct fourth points to -1. This proves disjointness over the algebraic closure. Each divisor is a thrice-punctured affine line over F3, proving all-extension counts. The packaged exact verifier passed pairwise saturation and independent finite-field checks.

value.rationale: The nonordinary locus of a natural two-dimensional genus-five curve family is fully classified at the smallest odd prime, with an unexpectedly sharp geometric 3-rank floor four. Its five rational divisor components are disjoint despite five independently variable elliptic quotients. The exact parameter frequencies over every extension and the associated a-number and Newton strata provide useful structural moduli information beyond a finite isolated computation.
